# kapsel-diag golden `ks-r001`. Regenerate with KAPSEL_BLESS=1.
# file: -c
--- input
false || true
--- output
error[KS-R001]: `|| true` discards the exit status of `false`
 --> -c:1:7
  |
1 | false || true
  | ----- ^^^^^^^
  | |
  | this command's failure is thrown away
  |
  = note: a failure turned into success cannot stop the script or reach the caller
  = help: handle the failure instead: `false || echo "false failed" >&2`

error: refused: 1 error
